name: list_integration_billing_plans
description:
Get a list of billing plans for an integration and product.

CLI fallback on MCP failure (partial): vercel api /v1/integrations/integration/{integrationIdOrSlug}/products/{productIdOrSlug}/plans --method GET. Fill placeholders from inputs.

slug.description: Team slug to use for this operation. Use instead of teamId.

teamId.description: Team ID to use for this operation.
